Grow your trade business on Geeb

Join the network of verified pros connecting with customers in your city. Free to apply, transparent fees, and the tools you need to run your business from your phone.

Why pros choose Geeb

More jobs. Less hassle. More of the work you love.

Whether you are an independent plumber or a multi-team HVAC company, Geeb gives you the customers, the tools, and the payouts — without the overhead of running your own marketing or dispatch.

A steady stream of jobs

Get matched with customers in your service area — no marketing, no chasing leads.

Set your own schedule

Pick the hours and days you want to work. Pause anytime, no minimum hours.

Transparent fees, fast payouts

A flat platform fee per job, no hidden cuts. Payouts to your bank within 24 hours.

Verified, reviewed customers

Every customer is real and rated. No-shows covered by our protection policy.

Tools to grow your business

Customer messaging, job history, performance analytics, and tax-ready reports.

Free to join, no commitment

No upfront cost, no exclusivity. Stay independent — Geeb is one more channel, not your boss.
